$comment: The EMPTY shape of the human-checked citation-support sample -- the
table the evidence-locator-validity metric is measured over. This file
holds the schema and no rows, because the human pass over produced
reports has not happened yet: a person reads the reports a run made,
judges each citation against the material, and records one row per
citation.
A FILLED TABLE LIVES OUTSIDE THIS REPOSITORY. It carries addresses into
the owner's unpublished manuscript, so committing it would leak the
corpus into a public tree. A filled table is handed to a run with
--citation-sample.
A row carries exactly five fields and no others:
sample_id   the row's own id, unique within the table
report      which produced report the citation is read from
record_id   the record of that report the citation is attached to
anchor_id   the address the citation points at, as the record carries it
verdict     what the human judged: "supported" or "unsupported"
There is no field for text. Not the claim, not the material's words,
not a reason: the loader refuses a row that carries a sixth field, and
the refusal is what keeps the manuscript out of the tree. A reader who
cannot decide a citation says so by leaving the row out, not by
inventing a third verdict.
An empty rows list is valid: the loader accepts this file, and the
metric built from it is NOT MEASURED, not a 0/0 rate.
label: empty -- no human pass over produced reports yet
